placeName.zh-CN: 中国浙江省湖州市德清县莫干山镇

details.direction: From Yuxin South Street through Moganshan’s bamboo forest, century-old trails, Jianchi, Naked Castle, the Republican-era villas and the town, returning to Zhezhe Yuan. The 100K is the full loop; 70K, 50K, 30K, 20K and 10K shorten it step by step.
details.distanceMethod: 2026 official regulations and course page give 99.0 km; this page does not average conflicting figures.
details.elevationMethod: 100K 5,903 m; 70K and 50K step down, with separate official profiles
details.attribution: 凯乐石莫干山跑山赛 2026：竹海、古道与 99 公里的十周年 / Kailas Moganshan Trail 2026: bamboo forest, ancient trails and 99 km in the tenth year. Race facts from the 2026 official notices and host-city government pages; editorial schematic only, no official track bundled.
